name: sandbox-mode
description: Sandbox mode: a site built from biome/difficulty/seed starts from nothing, honours the seed, and is fully playable through to a blast (#504: 3-control setup).

steps.description: No new_game first — a sandbox site is created from nothing, which is the point of the mode.
Biome and seed should match what was asked for. Grid extents are the fixed 64x32x64 default regardless of request (#504).

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:3 cols:3 spacing:4 depth:6 start:20,20

interaction.command: drill_plan grid rows:3 cols:3 spacing:4 depth:6 start:20,20
